zephem — architecture

Extracts the structure of a Zig module into pristine, self-verifying datasets — for LLM & static research.

pinned zig 0.16.0 16,506 decls 310 files max depth 8 toolchain Zig + Nushell

One source, read three ways

The extractor splits on the only axis that matters: what each engine reads. The parser reads Zig as text and emits one faithful file; reflect runs the compiler; derive reads only the datasets the first two produced. Everything flows one direction — a star, not a loop.

Two guarantees, proven every run

✓ True

Is what it says correct?

Every fact is extracted or computed — nothing authored. The data checks itself: conservation (Σ n_children = rows−1), referential integrity, and the parser's kinds vs the compiler's reflected kinds.

✓ Reproducible

Will building it again give the same thing?

The same Zig version rebuilds the byte-identical snapshot every time. --check proves it across two fresh rebuilds; PINNED records the exact version. These pages too — generated from the data by build_arch.nu, so their numbers can't drift.

Organize later — never in the parser

The parser emits only the faithful map. These are our organisation laid on top — each added back as its own layer once the base is settled. Preserved in git history.

Signatures + docswas decls

Each fn's as-written signature and any /// doc. Added detail, not structure.

Referenceswas tunnels

The resolved link graph — what name resolves to what. A "direction" the parser must not bake in.

Groupingclusters

Bucket the map by purpose. The most editorial of the three — deliberately last.
